Archlin’s Blueprint Document provides the agreed functional direction for Archlin’s Phase 1 Supply Management implementation and establishes the basis for subsequent configuration, validation, and adoption activities within Archlin’s planning organization.
1.1  Company Information
Archlin is a specialty chemicals manufacturing company undertaking a Phase 1 Kinax

The proposed solution direction is to support Archlin with a more structured, visible, and repeatable supply management planning process. The investment is intended to reduce reliance on disconnected Excel and manual activities by enabling planners to work with more consistent planning information for requirements, supply, purchase requisitions, and purchase orders. 2.2  Value Drivers
Archlin’s Phase 1 Kinaxis-enabled Supply Management investment is intended to create business value for Archlin by addressing poor inventory planning, limited supply visibility, raw material shortage visibility gaps, and planning cycle delays within Archlin’s specialty chemicals manufacturing planning environment.
